name: Three-pole gang-operated breaker reference
summary: Identifies a mechanism arrangement coordinating all three poles through its documented operation.
description: Identifies a mechanism arrangement coordinating all three poles through its documented operation. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Common mechanism command” at the input and “Three-pole operation” at the output. Simultaneous command does not imply identical contact timing.
